dialogues.jp: ガヤガヤと｛にぎ／賑｝わう廊下で辺りを見渡す。
dialogues.en: I looked around the noisy hallway.
dialogues.text: I looked around the noisy hallway.

dialogues.jp: 「本当に祭りの好きな学園だな」
dialogues.en: "They really love to party......"
dialogues.text: "They really love to party......"

dialogues.jp:
卒業式というよりも、学園祭でしかない様相に、
思わず呆れてしまう。
dialogues.en:
I was amazed at the graduation, which looks just like a
school festival.
dialogues.text:
I was amazed at the graduation, which looks just like a
school festival.

dialogues.jp: 午前中に幕を閉じた付属での生活。
dialogues.en: I'd finished my undergrad life as of this morning.
dialogues.text: I'd finished my undergrad life as of this morning.

dialogues.jp:
紙切れ１枚をもらうだけの卒業式だったが、な
んとなく区切りを感じさせるモノだった。
dialogues.en:
All I got was a piece of paper as the diploma, but it was
something to put an end to my life here.
dialogues.text:
All I got was a piece of paper as the diploma, but it was
something to put an end to my life here.

dialogues.jp:
だが……今までは感じなかったが、自分が卒業
する立場になると分かることがある。
dialogues.en:
Sometimes you don't understand things until they're
happening to you, but I felt something I never felt before.
dialogues.text:
Sometimes you don't understand things until they're
happening to you, but I felt something I never felt before.

dialogues.jp: 「もうちっと、俺達を祝おうや」
dialogues.en: "Can't you celebrate our achievements?"
dialogues.text: "Can't you celebrate our achievements?"

dialogues.jp: ――ガヤガヤ。
dialogues.en: Noisy hallway.
dialogues.text: Noisy hallway.

dialogues.jp:
卒業式では空気にのまれて泣いていた下級生も、
今はこの空気にのまれて笑っている。
dialogues.en:
Everybody's laughing with each other as they enjoy the
party, but they were crying at the graduation ceremony just
a while ago.
dialogues.text:
Everybody's laughing with each other as they enjoy the
party, but they were crying at the graduation ceremony just
a while ago.

dialogues.jp:
つまるところ、在校生の誰もが卒業式なんかよ
りもパーティーに心を躍らせていたのだ。
dialogues.en: I felt they're enjoying the party more than our graduation.
dialogues.text: I felt they're enjoying the party more than our graduation.

dialogues.jp: 「なんか悲しいぞ俺は」
dialogues.en: "That makes me sad."
dialogues.text: "That makes me sad."

dialogues.jp: 「せ〜んぱい♪」
dialogues.en: "Se~mpai."
dialogues.text: "Se~mpai."

dialogues.jp: 「よ、美春……と眞子」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Miharu...... and Mako."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Miharu...... and Mako."

dialogues.jp:
背中からの声に振りかえると、眞子と美春が仲
良く立っていた。
dialogues.en:
I turned around as someone called my name, and I found Mako
and Miharu standing there.
dialogues.text:
I turned around as someone called my name, and I found Mako
and Miharu standing there.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「えへへへ。卒業おめでとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Congratulations on your graduation."
dialogues.text: "Congratulations on your graduation."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「おぉ！　お前は良い奴だ」
dialogues.en: "Wow! You're such a nice girl."
dialogues.text: "Wow! You're such a nice girl."

dialogues.jp: いとおしく、ぎゅう、っと美春を抱きしめる。
dialogues.en: I hugged Miharu tightly.
dialogues.text: I hugged Miharu tightly.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉先輩っ、痛いです！」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Asakura-sempai, that hurts!!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Asakura-sempai, that hurts!!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「愛情表現だぞぉ」
dialogues.en: "I'm expressing my love."
dialogues.text: "I'm expressing my love."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「首です！　先輩、今掴んでいるのは首です！」
dialogues.en: "That's my neck! Sempai, you're grabbing my neck!"
dialogues.text: "That's my neck! Sempai, you're grabbing my neck!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「愛情の裏返しは憎しみだぞ〜」
dialogues.en: "The flip side of love is hate. You see?"
dialogues.text: "The flip side of love is hate. You see?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「全然関係ありませんよ〜！」
dialogues.en: "That isn't what we're talking about!"
dialogues.text: "That isn't what we're talking about!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はは、ありがとな美春」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, thanks, Miharu."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, thanks, Miharu."

dialogues.jp: ぱっ、と手を離して肩を叩く。
dialogues.en: I let her go, and tapped on her shoulder.
dialogues.text: I let her go, and tapped on her shoulder.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ほぇ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あ、やっぱ朝倉もこの状況に呆れてたんだ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, so you were feeling sad as well."
dialogues.text: "Oh, so you were feeling sad as well."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ああ。この素直な反応が嬉しいよな」
dialogues.en:
"Sure. I'm glad to see that someone else remembers the real
purpose of today."
dialogues.text:
"Sure. I'm glad to see that someone else remembers the real
purpose of today."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「周り中がこの雰囲気じゃあねぇ」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, everyone seems to forgotten that we're graduating
today."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, everyone seems to forgotten that we're graduating
today."

dialogues.jp:
困ったような笑みを浮かべて、眞子が肩をすく
めてみせる。
dialogues.en: Mako shrugged her shoulders and smiled.
dialogues.text: Mako shrugged her shoulders and smiled.

dialogues.jp: 「情緒もへったくれもない」
dialogues.en: "No sentiment whatsoever."
dialogues.text: "No sentiment whatsoever."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、去年はうちらを見て、お姉ちゃんとか
　はそう思ってたのかもね」
dialogues.en:
"I wonder if oneechan was feeling the same as this last
year."
dialogues.text:
"I wonder if oneechan was feeling the same as this last
year."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「たまらん伝統だな」
dialogues.en: "What a lame tradition."
dialogues.text: "What a lame tradition."

dialogues.jp: 思わず天井を見上げてしまう。
dialogues.en: I looked up at the ceiling.
dialogues.text: I looked up at the ceiling.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉はなんか用事でもあるの？」
dialogues.en: "Do you have something you need to do?"
dialogues.text: "Do you have something you need to do?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「いや、今年はぶらぶらと辺りを散策してみよ
　うかと」
dialogues.en:
"Not really. I was thinking about wandering around this
year."
dialogues.text:
"Not really. I was thinking about wandering around this
year."

dialogues.jp: 思わず言葉を濁す。
dialogues.en: I left it at that.
dialogues.text: I left it at that.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「えぇ？！　朝倉先輩なにもしないんです
　か！？」
dialogues.en: "What? You aren't planning anything?!"
dialogues.text: "What? You aren't planning anything?!"

dialogues.jp: 首をさすっていた美春が、ばっ、と顔を上げる。
dialogues.en: Miharu looked at me while rubbing her neck.
dialogues.text: Miharu looked at me while rubbing her neck.

dialogues.jp: 「……なんだその反応は」
dialogues.en: "What? Am I supposed to do something?"
dialogues.text: "What? Am I supposed to do something?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「だって朝倉先輩ですよ！？　卒業式に騒ぎを
　起こさないはずないじゃないですかぁ！」
dialogues.en:
"It's you we're talking about. You've got to have a plan to
stir up the crowd!"
dialogues.text:
"It's you we're talking about. You've got to have a plan to
stir up the crowd!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「前言撤回だ。お前、風紀委員として俺の様子
　をうかがいに来たな？」
dialogues.en:
"I see why you came. You came to check on me as a member of
the school committee, didn't you?"
dialogues.text:
"I see why you came. You came to check on me as a member of
the school committee, didn't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「な、なんのことやら？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? What are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? What are you talking about?"

dialogues.jp: ピーピー、と鳴りきれてない口笛を吹く。
dialogues.en: She tries to whistle.
dialogues.text: She tries to whistle.

dialogues.jp:
「せっかく、去年のクリスマスパーティーで約
　束したままだったチョコバナナを｛おご／奢｝ってやろ
　うと思ったのに」
dialogues.en:
"And I was just thinking about buying your favorite dessert
for you like I promised at the Christmas party last year."
dialogues.text:
"And I was just thinking about buying your favorite dessert
for you like I promised at the Christmas party last year."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「え！　朝倉先輩っ、それは……」
dialogues.en: "What? Asakura-sempai, you mean...?"
dialogues.text: "What? Asakura-sempai, you mean...?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、もったいない」
dialogues.en: "Man, you threw it out the window."
dialogues.text: "Man, you threw it out the window."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「お代官様〜、美春にお慈悲を〜」
dialogues.en: "Oh, come on. Give me one more chance!"
dialogues.text: "Oh, come on. Give me one more chance!"

dialogues.jp: 両手を組んで美春が、よよよ、と泣きに入る。
dialogues.en: Miharu crossed her hands and acted like she was crying.
dialogues.text: Miharu crossed her hands and acted like she was crying.

dialogues.jp: 「……さぁて、どうしてくれようか」
dialogues.en: "Hmm...... What should I do?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm...... What should I do?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ここに｛こがね／黄金｝色のお饅頭が」
dialogues.en: "Oh, look! Here's a bag of gold coins, your majesty."
dialogues.text: "Oh, look! Here's a bag of gold coins, your majesty."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ほほぉ。そちも悪よの天枷屋」
dialogues.en: "Hum. A bribe...... You're such a bad merchant."
dialogues.text: "Hum. A bribe...... You're such a bad merchant."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「いえいえ、お代官様ほどでは」
dialogues.en: "Not at all, your majesty."
dialogues.text: "Not at all, your majesty."

dialogues.jp: ニヤリ、と美春が笑みを浮かべた。
dialogues.en:
Miharu grinned at me, acting like a merchant trying to bribe
the king or something.
dialogues.text:
Miharu grinned at me, acting like a merchant trying to bribe
the king or something.

dialogues.jp:
「しかしな……わしはそんなモノよりお前を頂
　くぞ〜！」
dialogues.en:
"Well...... but you look like a more fascinating bribe to
me!"
dialogues.text:
"Well...... but you look like a more fascinating bribe to
me!"

dialogues.jp:
美春が着物を着ていることにして、帯をひっぱ
る真似をする。
dialogues.en:
I acted as if Miharu had a dress on, and I tried to undress
her.
dialogues.text:
I acted as if Miharu had a dress on, and I tried to undress
her.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "Oh, please! Your majesty!"
dialogues.text: "Oh, please! Your majesty!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ふははははは！」
dialogues.en: "Ha ha!"
dialogues.text: "Ha ha!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "Oh no!"
dialogues.text: "Oh no!"

dialogues.jp: くるくる、美春が回る。
dialogues.en: Miharu spins around.
dialogues.text: Miharu spins around.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あんたら……よく、そう波に乗れるわねぇ」
dialogues.en: "You guys...... are so stupid."
dialogues.text: "You guys...... are so stupid."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あはははは。眞子先輩もやりますかぁ？」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha. Do you want to join, Mako-sempai?"
dialogues.text: "Hahaha. Do you want to join, Mako-sempai?"

dialogues.jp: ぴたり、と眞子のほうを向いて美春が止まる。
dialogues.en: Miharu stopped to look at Mako.
dialogues.text: Miharu stopped to look at Mako.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あたし？　あたしがやると役がなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "Me? Who can I be?"
dialogues.text: "Me? Who can I be?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「お前だと仕事人か、話の真ん中くらいで風呂
　に入ることになるくの一だよな」
dialogues.en: "You'd be like a servant, or a crown?"
dialogues.text: "You'd be like a servant, or a crown?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「言うと思ったのよ、あんたは……」
dialogues.en: "I knew you'd say that......"
dialogues.text: "I knew you'd say that......"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あははははは」
dialogues.en: "Hahahahaha!"
dialogues.text: "Hahahahaha!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、もう！」
dialogues.en: "Shut up!"
dialogues.text: "Shut up!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ははは」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha."

dialogues.jp: 久しぶりの感触だった。
dialogues.en: I felt like this for the first time in a long time.
dialogues.text: I felt like this for the first time in a long time.

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく夏休みが終わった後、久しぶりにク
ラスメートと会った時の楽しさだ。
dialogues.en:
It was like seeing my classmates for the first time after
the summer vacation.
dialogues.text:
It was like seeing my classmates for the first time after
the summer vacation.

dialogues.jp:
……まぁ、残ってる宿題のおかげでそれどころ
ではないんだけど。
dialogues.en:
Well, it's usually not that sentimental after the summer
vacation because of the unfinished homework assignments.
dialogues.text:
Well, it's usually not that sentimental after the summer
vacation because of the unfinished homework assignments.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「まったく……しかし、元気そうで良かった」
dialogues.en: "Anyways...... I'm glad you look okay."
dialogues.text: "Anyways...... I'm glad you look okay."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 美春の頭をぐりぐり、と抱え込みながら呟く。
dialogues.en: I mumbled as I held Miharu's head and gave her the knuckles.
dialogues.text: I mumbled as I held Miharu's head and gave her the knuckles.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なんか元気がなさそうだったからね」
dialogues.en: "You seemed sad."
dialogues.text: "You seemed sad."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「そうか？」
dialogues.en: "I did?"
dialogues.text: "I did?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん。音夢先輩もしばらくおかしいですし
　ね」
dialogues.en: "Yeah. And Nemu-sempai's been acting weird for a while too."
dialogues.text: "Yeah. And Nemu-sempai's been acting weird for a while too."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そうか」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.jp:
実際のところ、卒業式よりも音夢との仲のこと
で最近は頭がいっぱいだった。
dialogues.en:
To be honest, I was more concerned about our relationship
than graduation.
dialogues.text:
To be honest, I was more concerned about our relationship
than graduation.

dialogues.jp: 家にいても気まずいし。
dialogues.en: It was awkward to be at home with her.
dialogues.text: It was awkward to be at home with her.

dialogues.jp:
食事とか夜のテレビ以外は、音夢はなるべく顔
を合わせないように行動してるからな……。
dialogues.en:
Nemu's avoiding me except for mealtimes and when she watches
the TV.
dialogues.text:
Nemu's avoiding me except for mealtimes and when she watches
the TV.

dialogues.jp: これほど避けられたのは初めてだ。
dialogues.en: It was my first time to be avoided like that.
dialogues.text: It was my first time to be avoided like that.

dialogues.jp:
以前は、間違って音夢のいる風呂に入ってしまっ
たときか……。
dialogues.en:
Last time she avoided me was when I went into the shower
room by mistake while she was taking a shower.
dialogues.text:
Last time she avoided me was when I went into the shower
room by mistake while she was taking a shower.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「どうしました先輩？　顔赤いですけど風邪で
　すか？」
dialogues.en:
"What happened, sempai? Your face's red. Do you have a
fever?"
dialogues.text:
"What happened, sempai? Your face's red. Do you have a
fever?"

dialogues.jp:
ぬぅっ、と腕から抜け出した美春が顔を覗きこ
んでくる。
dialogues.en: Miharu looked into my face as she got loose from my arm.
dialogues.text: Miharu looked into my face as she got loose from my arm.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「眞子先輩、音楽部の発表会の準備があるって、
　行っちゃいましたよ〜」
dialogues.en: "Mako-sempai left to prepare for the music club's recital."
dialogues.text: "Mako-sempai left to prepare for the music club's recital."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、そうか」
dialogues.en: "Oh, yeah?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, yeah?"

dialogues.jp:
色々と道を逸れた思考を浮かべている間に、呆
れられたらしい。
dialogues.en:
I guess she became fed up with me as I was wondering to
myself.
dialogues.text:
I guess she became fed up with me as I was wondering to
myself.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり、ぼ〜っとしてますね」
dialogues.en: "You're spacing out."
dialogues.text: "You're spacing out."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そうか」
dialogues.en: "Oh, yeah?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, yeah?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そうか、って口癖になってますよ」
dialogues.en: "You keep saying "Oh, yeah?" over and over."
dialogues.text: "You keep saying "Oh, yeah?" over and over."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そうでもない」
dialogues.en: "Not really."
dialogues.text: "Not really."

dialogues.jp: 心配させまいとニヤリ、と笑ってみせる。
dialogues.en: I grinned to tell her that I'm OK.
dialogues.text: I grinned to tell her that I'm OK.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「騒ぎを起こさないで下さいね。今年なにかあ
　ると、美春が卒業するときに色々決まり事が
　出来ちゃうかも知れないですから」
dialogues.en:
"Just behave yourself, okay? If something happens this year,
then the school might come up with more rules and
regulations when I graduate."
dialogues.text:
"Just behave yourself, okay? If something happens this year,
then the school might come up with more rules and
regulations when I graduate."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「お前、段々と音夢に似てきたな」
dialogues.en: "You sound just like Nemu."
dialogues.text: "You sound just like Nemu."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あはははは……大丈夫そうですね。では、ア
　デュ〜です先輩！」
dialogues.en: "Well, you sound fine. All right then, farewell!!"
dialogues.text: "Well, you sound fine. All right then, farewell!!"

dialogues.jp: にぱにぱ、と手を開いてお見送りをする。
dialogues.en: I opened and closed my hand to wave good bye.
dialogues.text: I opened and closed my hand to wave good bye.

dialogues.jp: その手を止めて、はぁ、と溜息をついた。
dialogues.en: I stopped waving and sighed.
dialogues.text: I stopped waving and sighed.

dialogues.jp: 「……案外鋭いなあのふたりは」
dialogues.en: "......They're looking more closely than I thought."
dialogues.text: "......They're looking more closely than I thought."

dialogues.jp:
特に美春のやつは、音夢にまでちょっかいだし
てるはずだから、薄々気づいているのかも知れ
ない。
dialogues.en:
Especially Miharu... she might know more than I think as
she's close to Nemu as well.
dialogues.text:
Especially Miharu... she might know more than I think as
she's close to Nemu as well.

dialogues.jp:
義理の兄妹の関係がばれるのとばれないのでは、
どっちがいいのか……。
dialogues.en:
I don't know if it's better to have everyone know about our
relationship or not. That we aren't blood related.
dialogues.text:
I don't know if it's better to have everyone know about our
relationship or not. That we aren't blood related.

dialogues.jp: 「とりあえず、今度バナナでも奢る――」
dialogues.en: "Well, I'll buy you something next time......"
dialogues.text: "Well, I'll buy you something next time......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「まったく、確かこの辺りで……あ」
dialogues.en: "I thought it was around here...... oh."
dialogues.text: "I thought it was around here...... oh."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: ぱっ、と音夢と目が合ってしまう。
dialogues.en: Nemu and I looked at each other in the eye.
dialogues.text: Nemu and I looked at each other in the eye.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉くん。こんにちは」
dialogues.en: "Hi, Asakura-kun. How are you?"
dialogues.text: "Hi, Asakura-kun. How are you?"

dialogues.jp:
音夢と一緒に歩いていたことりが慌てて頭を下
げる。
dialogues.en: Kotori and Nemu were walking together and Kotori greeted me.
dialogues.text: Kotori and Nemu were walking together and Kotori greeted me.

dialogues.jp: 音夢と俺の反応にとまどっているのだろう。
dialogues.en: Maybe she felt something was going on between Nemu and me.
dialogues.text: Maybe she felt something was going on between Nemu and me.

dialogues.jp: 「よ、ふたりとも卒業おめでとう」
dialogues.en: "Hey. Congratulations, you two."
dialogues.text: "Hey. Congratulations, you two."

dialogues.jp: 何気ない素振りで笑う。
dialogues.en: I tried to be casual and smiled.
dialogues.text: I tried to be casual and smiled.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「おめでとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Congratulations."
dialogues.text: "Congratulations."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おめでとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Congratulations."
dialogues.text: "Congratulations."

dialogues.jp: 正反対の表情でふたりが同じことを言う。
dialogues.en:
They both said the same thing with different facial
expressions.
dialogues.text:
They both said the same thing with different facial
expressions.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あはははは」
dialogues.en: "A-Ahahaha."
dialogues.text: "A-Ahahaha."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それでは、見回りの途中なので失礼します」
dialogues.en: "Well, we're in the middle of patrol, so good bye."
dialogues.text: "Well, we're in the middle of patrol, so good bye."

dialogues.jp:
有能過ぎる秘書のように、音夢は軽くお辞儀を
して通り過ぎる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu gave me a light bow like a perfect secretary, and
walked away.
dialogues.text:
Nemu gave me a light bow like a perfect secretary, and
walked away.

dialogues.jp: 「音夢」
dialogues.en: "Nemu."
dialogues.text: "Nemu."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ……なにか用ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Yes? What do you need?"
dialogues.text: "Yes? What do you need?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いや、時間があったら一緒に回ろうよ」
dialogues.en: "Do you want to walk around with me if you have time?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want to walk around with me if you have time?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「っ、あ……ううん……いえ、忙しいから」
dialogues.en: "Well...... no, I'm kind of busy."
dialogues.text: "Well...... no, I'm kind of busy."

dialogues.jp: なにか言いたげなのに、言葉を呑みこむ仕草。
dialogues.en: She seems not to say whatever she wanted to say.
dialogues.text: She seems not to say whatever she wanted to say.

dialogues.jp:
分かりやすいだけに、逆にかける言葉が見つか
らない。
dialogues.en:
It was too easy for me to imagine, and that made it harder
for me to talk to her.
dialogues.text:
It was too easy for me to imagine, and that made it harder
for me to talk to her.

dialogues.jp: 「ん？　お前、ちょっと顔色が悪くないか？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, you look sick."
dialogues.text: "Hey, you look sick."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「最近、朝の日課をやってなかったから――」
dialogues.en: "We haven't been doing the morning check lately......"
dialogues.text: "We haven't been doing the morning check lately......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いいです！」
dialogues.en: "I'm fine!"
dialogues.text: "I'm fine!"

dialogues.jp:
おでこに手を伸ばそうとするのだが、音夢は首
を振って下がってしまう。
dialogues.en:
I reached my hand out to her forehead, but Nemu shook her
head and stepped back.
dialogues.text:
I reached my hand out to her forehead, but Nemu shook her
head and stepped back.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「私……子供じゃないんです」
dialogues.en: "I'm not a child anymore."
dialogues.text: "I'm not a child anymore."

dialogues.jp:
小さく呟いて、音夢がきびすを返して歩いてい
く。
dialogues.en: She mumbled and turned around to leave me.
dialogues.text: She mumbled and turned around to leave me.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あ、朝倉さん！　――いえ、朝倉くんのこと
　じゃないですよ」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Asakura-san! ...Oh, I don't mean you, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Asakura-san! ...Oh, I don't mean you, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、うん。俺のことは気にしなくていいから」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, don't worry about me."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, don't worry about me."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あの……喧嘩？」
dialogues.en: "Are you guys fighting?"
dialogues.text: "Are you guys fighting?"

dialogues.jp:
去って行く音夢の背中を気にしながら、ことり
が｛ささや／囁｝く。
dialogues.en: Kotori whispered, worrying about Nemu as she walked off.
dialogues.text: Kotori whispered, worrying about Nemu as she walked off.

dialogues.jp: 「それとはまた違うかな」
dialogues.en: "It's not like that."
dialogues.text: "It's not like that."

dialogues.jp:
自分でも上手く説明できない状況に、肩をすく
める。
dialogues.en:
I shrugged my shoulders because even I wasn't sure what was
going on.
dialogues.text:
I shrugged my shoulders because even I wasn't sure what was
going on.

dialogues.jp:
「とりあえず、すまないけどあいつの調子、見
　ていてくれないかな」
dialogues.en: "Could you watch her closely for me?"
dialogues.text: "Could you watch her closely for me?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「私に任せてくださいな」
dialogues.en: "Sure. You can count on me."
dialogues.text: "Sure. You can count on me."

dialogues.jp: どん、と胸を叩いてことりが手を振る。
dialogues.en: Kotori assured me and waved her hand.
dialogues.text: Kotori assured me and waved her hand.

dialogues.jp: 「今度、なにか……甘い物でも奢るよ」
dialogues.en: "I'll buy you something sweet next time."
dialogues.text: "I'll buy you something sweet next time."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「はい、楽しみにしてます……ふふ、妹さん想
　いなんですね」
dialogues.en:
"Great. I'll be looking forward to that. You're such a nice
brother."
dialogues.text:
"Great. I'll be looking forward to that. You're such a nice
brother."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そんなんじゃない」
dialogues.en: "It's not like that..."
dialogues.text: "It's not like that..."

dialogues.jp: 届かないことを知りつつ、ことりの背中に呟く。
dialogues.en:
I mumbled at Kotori as she was leaving, hoping she wouldn't
hear it.
dialogues.text:
I mumbled at Kotori as she was leaving, hoping she wouldn't
hear it.

dialogues.jp: 「まったく」
dialogues.en: "Oh man."
dialogues.text: "Oh man."

dialogues.jp: 溜息をついて、頭を抱えた。
dialogues.en: I sighed.
dialogues.text: I sighed.

dialogues.jp: 「迷惑ばっかりかけやがって」
dialogues.en: "She's such a handful."
dialogues.text: "She's such a handful."

dialogues.jp: 音夢の消えた廊下をジッと見つめた。
dialogues.en: What a pain.
dialogues.text: What a pain.

dialogues.jp: ◆素っ気ない音夢◆
dialogues.en: ◆Nemu acting cold.◆
dialogues.text: ◆Nemu acting cold.◆

dialogues.jp:
卒業式なんかよりもパーティーに心を躍らせて
いる在校生たちに、呆れてしまう。もう少し俺
たちを祝おうや。
dialogues.en:
Everybody's looking forward to the after party and that made
me sad. Why can't they be more sentimental for graduating
students?
dialogues.text:
Everybody's looking forward to the after party and that made
me sad. Why can't they be more sentimental for graduating
students?

dialogues.jp: 素直に喜んでくれるのは美春だけか。
dialogues.en: The only person who congratulated me was Miharu.
dialogues.text: The only person who congratulated me was Miharu.

dialogues.jp:
音夢とことりにも会ったけど、音夢はそっけな
く挨拶をして行ってしまった。まったく、心配
ばかりかける妹だ。
dialogues.en:
I ran into Nemu and Kotori, but Nemu seemed to be avoiding
me. Why's she causing trouble like that?
dialogues.text:
I ran into Nemu and Kotori, but Nemu seemed to be avoiding
me. Why's she causing trouble like that?
